title: lichen/link/tx_queue.py fails strict mypy (2 errors) and ruff format gate
description: Discovered while working project-LICHEN-worker6-3w7e (identity fix in complete(); unrelated lines). Pre-existing on main, verified via git stash. (1) mypy strict: src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py:164 union-attr (AbstractEventLoop | None has no call_soon_threadsafe) and :291 assignment (Callable[..., object] vs Callable[[], int] clock). Project gate per pyproject.toml kpv0.9 contract is strict mypy converged to zero, so the gate is red for this file. (2) ruff format --check wants reformatting at lines ~99, ~151, ~163 (_future_loop field and call_soon_threadsafe/on_owning_loop wrapping). Fix both without touching behavior; keep complete()'s identity semantics from 3w7e intact.
close_reason: Fixed both strict-mypy errors and the ruff format gate for tx_queue.py. (1) :164 union-attr — set_result now captures self._future_loop into a local before the future check; the foreign-thread marshal branch is 'elif loop is not None'. Only behavior delta: the previously-impossible None-loop-with-set-future path (wait() captures _future_loop together with _future) now skips the marshal instead of AttributeError-ing; the recorded _result is applied by wait()'s pre-set catch-up, so no consumer-visible change. (2) :291 assignment — set_pkt_id_source validates via require_sync_callable then assigns the original argument (mirrors __init__'s existing pattern; require_sync_callable returns its input unchanged). (3) ruff format rewrap only. Verification: mypy src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py — tx_queue errors 2→0 (total 68→66; remainder are pre-existing errors in other files, out of this bead's scope); ruff format --check + ruff check clean; tests/link/test_tx_queue.py 94/94 via .venv/bin/python (system python3 lacks the installed lora_medium module — environment note for future workers: run pytest with .venv). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS (no un-marshaled result path; no non-sync callable can slip through), edge-cases PASS (needed one retry after timeout; scoped hunks only). COMMIT NOTE: the fix content landed inside bd's auto store-sync commit 13a7c23a1f (bd auto-commit swept the working tree mid-round; git show --stat verified it contains exactly python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py 12+/18- and nothing else), so no separate fix commit exists — the chore(beads) message on 13a7c23a1f mislabels this content.
